message: A small weekend house with two bedrooms and an open kitchen-living — got it, and I've taken it as a single home on your 18 × 24 m plot. Two quick things: how many people should it comfortably sleep, and do you want any extras like a utility room, terrace or storage? Anything else I should know is welcome too.

brief.notes: A small weekend house — two bedrooms, an open kitchen with the living room, one bathroom.

questions.question: How many people should the house comfortably sleep?
Any extras you'd like alongside the four rooms?
Anything else we should know about how you'll use the house?

assumptions.basis: A weekend house for one household — one home, in plain words.
Single-storey single home, no barrier-free need mentioned.
Single storey — the only option in this version.
Comfortable ceiling height with room for floor and ceiling build-up.
